findings.message: 3 tl.fromTo() calls target "#cz-1" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.
This 18 s film has no sound source (no <audio>, no <video> with sound): add a music bed and sounds on the visible actions unless the person asked for silence; see references/sound.md.

Type floor is 28 px (2.6% of the 1080 px short side, what a phone can read) and 3 text elements stay under it for 0.5 s or more, the smallest "NATURE AUDIO TOUR" at 22 px: set reading text to at least 28 px, or put data-layout-ignore on text that is texture rather than reading; see references/look.md.
